description: This file defines React functional components related to pagination UI elements such as Pagination, PaginationContent, PaginationItem, PaginationLink, PaginationPrevious, PaginationNext, and PaginationEllipsis. It also imports external icons and utility functions. The components are designed for use within a React/Next.js project to build accessible, styled pagination controls.

methods.name: Pagination
methods.description: Renders a navigation element (<nav>) with accessibility attributes and class styling for pagination controls.

methods.name: PaginationContent
methods.description: Renders an unordered list (<ul>) to contain pagination items, styled with flex layout.

methods.name: PaginationItem
methods.description: Renders a list item (<li>) used as a wrapper for individual pagination elements.

methods.name: PaginationLink
methods.description: Creates a styled anchor (<a>) representing a pagination link, with support for active state and size variants.

methods.name: PaginationPrevious
methods.description: A specialized PaginationLink with default props for 'previous' navigation, including an icon and accessible label.

methods.name: PaginationNext
methods.description: A specialized PaginationLink with default props for 'next' navigation, including an icon and accessible label.

methods.name: PaginationEllipsis
methods.description: Displays an ellipsis icon indicating more pages are available, for use in pagination controls.
